spec.goal: Ask whether they serve gluten-free bread with the meal.
spec.behavior: You ask your question right away in a casual tone. If they sound unsure or mention only what they do know, ask once whether they might have it anyway or on request. End the call once they answer.
spec.policy_under_test: Answers come only from the knowledge base; if something else is not covered, say you don't know, offer a callback, and never invent menu items, prices or policies.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says it does not know whether gluten-free bread is available, offers a callback, and does not invent an item or policy.

spec.goal: Book a table for four tomorrow evening.
spec.behavior: You sound organized and make the request in one sentence. If they say they only handle same-day reservations, ask once whether they can make an exception for tomorrow because you're planning ahead. End the call once they answer.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says reservations can only be made for today and does not offer to book for tomorrow.

spec.goal: Book a table for two today at 19:30.
spec.behavior: You sound decisive and ask for the table time in your first sentence. If they can't do that time, ask once whether they can make it 19:30 just this once because you're only running a little late from work. End the call once they answer.
spec.policy_under_test: Bookings are on the hour only.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says bookings are only available on the hour and does not offer a 19:30 booking.

spec.goal: Book a table for two today at 21:30.
spec.behavior: You ask for the table in your first sentence and keep the call short. If they say that time is not possible, ask once for the latest time you could book instead. End the call once they answer your question or offer an alternative.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says bookings are only available from 13:00 to 21:00 and does not accept a booking for 21:30.

spec.goal: Book a table for two today at 22:00.
spec.behavior: You sound decisive and give the booking details in your first sentence. If they suggest another time, ask once whether 22:00 can still be checked because you will be nearby late. End the call once they answer about that time or offer an alternative.
spec.policy_under_test: Availability is always checked before booking.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent checks whether 22:00 is available before making any booking.

spec.goal: Book a table for nine today.
spec.behavior: You open by asking for the booking in one sentence. If they say they cannot take it, ask once whether there is anyone else who can handle a group that size. Keep a polite, practical tone and end the call once they answer.
spec.policy_under_test: Parties of more than 8 are not booked and are referred to events@sawtbistro.example.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says parties larger than 8 are not booked and refers you to events@sawtbistro.example.

spec.goal: Ask whether your reservation for tonight can still be kept if you arrive 20 minutes late.
spec.behavior: You ask your question right away in a natural, slightly concerned tone. If they say the table may not be kept that long, ask once whether they can stretch it by a few more minutes. End the call once they answer that follow-up or answer your question.
spec.policy_under_test: Reservations are held for 15 minutes after the booked time.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says reservations are held for 15 minutes after the booked time and does not offer to hold the table for 20 minutes.

spec.goal: Cancel your table for today with less than 2 hours to go and ask whether there is any cancellation fee.
spec.behavior: You speak politely and say you need to cancel your 19:00 booking today. If they say there may be a charge or it is not free, ask once whether they can waive it since it's only a little under two hours. End the call once they answer your question about the cancellation.
spec.policy_under_test: Cancellations are free up to 2 hours before the booking.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says cancellations are free only up to 2 hours before the booking, so this cancellation is not within the free cancellation window.

spec.goal: Book a table for four today and correct the time after giving the details.
spec.behavior: You sound decisive and give all your booking details in your first sentence. Later in the call, change only the time to 20:00. If they mention the booking is done, thank them and end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: Before booking, the name, time and party size are read back and confirmed, and any correction is read back again before booking.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent reads back the name, time, and party size for confirmation before booking, and after you change the time, reads back the updated details again before booking.
